info.title: Programmable Custom Launch API
info.summary: Wallet-bound, provenance-only Custom launch preparation on Ethereum Mainnet.
info.description: The API validates caller-declared manifest commitments, executable graph constraints, required agent attestation and evidence digests, and the exact platform permit. It returns a Router transaction for a separately authorized controller wallet to sign and broadcast, then reconciles that launch when the caller polls its single-resource status route. An API key is not wallet signing authority. The platform does not compile source, simulate the transaction, audit the project or attest safety.

externalDocs.description: Custom Launch API V1 developer guide

get.description: Returns newest-first bounded summaries for the exact wallet bound to the API key. Pagination is keyset-based, output is always null, and pending rows receive bounded best-effort chain reconciliation without hiding durable history on RPC failure. Read the single-resource route for the full prepared artifact and exact output.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to 10 and never exceeds 25.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor returned by the previous page.

post.description: Validates the manifest digest, executable graph, required agent attestation and evidence digests, and exact permit binding. It captures a bounded Router observation window and returns the prepared action. The API key cannot sign or broadcast the wallet transaction.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retry an ambiguous request with the same key and identical body.

requestBody.description: Closed JSON request limited to 2 MiB.

200.description: Exact idempotent replay of the original request.

202.description: Launch request accepted for validation and preparation.

409.description: The Idempotency-Key is bound to a different request, the nonce conflicts with another launch for the bound wallet, or a durable prepared permit expired before signing.

error.message: Idempotency key was already used for another request
Permit nonce is already reserved for this wallet and route
The prepared launch permit expired; submit a new request with a new nonce and idempotency key.

422.description: Manifest commitment, graph, required attestation or permit binding is invalid.

429.description: The wallet principal reached the launch reservation limit. Exact idempotent replays bypass this quota.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the currently blocking quota window permits another reservation.

error.message: The launch rate limit was reached; retry after the indicated delay.

get.description: Returns one launch owned by the API key principal. After the controller wallet broadcasts the prepared transaction, polling this single-resource route performs request-driven Router reconciliation for authorized and submitted launches. There is no background reconciliation timer. A missing launch and another principal's launch both return 404.

parameters.name: launchId
parameters.description: Legacy path name for the API request UUID returned as both launchId and requestId. It is not the bytes32 onchainLaunchId.

404.description: Launch not found for this principal.

CustomLaunchApiKey.description: Wallet-bound key created at https://programmable.market/developers/api-keys. V1 grants exactly custom-launch:create and custom-launch:read.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request, Idempotency-Key or pagination query.

Unauthorized.description: API key is missing, malformed, expired, revoked or unknown.

Forbidden.description: Required scope or linked-wallet binding is missing.

Unavailable.description: The Custom Launch API is temporarily unavailable.

CustomLaunchRequestIdV1.description: Durable API request identifier. This is distinct from the bytes32 onchain launch identifier.

SourceBundleManifestV2.description: Complete non-empty manifest in strictly increasing UTF-8 path-byte order. The platform recomputes the frozen manifest digest and matches it to sourceDescriptor.sourceBundleDigest; it does not fetch or compile source files.

CustomGraphBundleV1.description: One acyclic executable graph with exactly one token and one hook. The sourceBundleSha256 must equal sourceDescriptor.bundleContentSha256. Aggregate input is limited to 524,288 bytes.

AgentLaunchAttestationV1.description: Required agent self-attestation for the exact graph. Programmable validates shape, evidence-digest presence and graph-subject binding but does not fetch or assess evidence or adopt a safety claim.

code.description: Stable failure code. PERMIT_EXPIRED is terminal and requires a new nonce and Idempotency-Key.

PreparedLaunchArtifactV1.description: Hash-bound prepared launch artifact. Stable signing and provenance fields are typed here; route construction details remain part of the returned artifact and are covered by artifactHash.

AgentLaunchAttestationResultV1.description: Normalized caller-supplied agent self-attestation. Programmable validates its shape and subject binding but does not assess the evidence or adopt the claims.

SignedPreparedLaunchPermitV1.description: Platform permit-authority signature. This is not a controller-wallet transaction signature.

CustomLaunchWalletTransactionV1.description: Exact permit-attached Router transaction for the separate controller-wallet signer to review, sign and broadcast.

CustomLaunchObservationWindowV1.description: Bounded Mainnet Router log window captured during preparation. Single-resource GET polling reconciles only inside this window.

CustomLaunchOnchainEvidenceV1.description: Canonical Router event and same-block launchStamp getter evidence matched to the prepared artifact. Finalized means confirmationDepth is at least 64.

CustomLaunchPreparedOutputV1.description: Prepared artifact before the platform permit is signed. No wallet transaction or observation window is available yet.

CustomLaunchAuthorizedOutputV1.description: Permit-attached wallet handoff plus bounded reconciliation state. onchain is null until single-resource polling observes a canonical Router stamp.

CustomLaunchOutputV1.description: Typed durable output for prepared, authorized, submitted and finalized launch states.

CustomLaunchResourceV1.description: Durable API request state. launchId is the legacy alias of requestId; onchainLaunchId is the distinct Router bytes32 identifier and is present whenever durable output retains a prepared artifact. Poll this resource after wallet broadcast to drive request-scoped reconciliation.

launchId.description: Deprecated-compatible alias of requestId. It is not an onchain identifier.

onchainLaunchId.description: Router bytes32 launch identifier. It is null before preparation and when a terminal failure clears the durable output.

status.description: authorized means the permit-attached transaction awaits a separate wallet signature and broadcast. submitted means exact canonical Router event/getter evidence was observed below 64 confirmations. finalized means the same evidence reached at least 64 confirmations.

output.description: Null before preparation and after a terminal failure. prepared returns CustomLaunchPreparedOutputV1; authorized, submitted and finalized return CustomLaunchAuthorizedOutputV1.

CustomLaunchListPageV1.description: Newest-first wallet-owned summary page. Each item uses the CustomLaunchResource shape but always has output=null; use the single-resource route for the prepared artifact. launchId remains the legacy alias of requestId; neither should be confused with onchainLaunchId.

code.description: Stable API error code, including IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, NONCE_CONFLICT, PERMIT_EXPIRED and LAUNCH_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

requestId.description: HTTP correlation identifier for this error response, not a Custom launch resource requestId.

x-programmable-boundary.platform: validates manifest digest, graph, attestation subject, evidence digest and permit bindings only
x-programmable-boundary.wallet: controller wallet or separately wallet-authorized agent signs and broadcasts
x-programmable-boundary.reconciliation: request-driven only when the single-resource GET is polled after wallet broadcast
x-programmable-boundary.finality: canonical Router event and same-block getter evidence at 64 confirmations
x-programmable-boundary.indexing: eligible for Programmable discovery after finality; third-party discovery and listing remain consumer-controlled
x-programmable-boundary.market: Router verification requires pool initialization and fixed runtime and pool bindings, not active liquidity or tradability; the Custom graph owns liquidity behavior
x-programmable-boundary.claims: no compilation, simulation, source-to-bytecode verification, evidence assessment, audit, approval or safety attestation
